The dish looks like tuna salad with celery, red onion and carrot, served on a square plate. I used the plate as the ruler.

The plate is about 400 px wide in the photo. If it is a 24-26 cm plate, that gives roughly 0.06 cm per px. The food mound is about 220 px wide and 240 px tall, which is about 13 cm by 14 cm. That is a fairly small pile, probably 2-3 cm high.

Estimated volume: about 13 × 12 × 2.5 cm × 0.6 for the rounded shape, or roughly 230 cm³. At a density of about 0.9 g/cm³ that is about 200 g. A typical scoop of tuna salad is 150-200 g, so I settled on about 170 g.

Tuna salad made with mayo runs about 180-200 kcal per 100 g, so 170 g comes to roughly 300 kcal. The salad looks lightly dressed, so I lowered that slightly to 290 kcal.
